description: 回复区 AI 打分的样例集：构造的对话，每条回复标好预期（ai / human）。followers（粉丝数）和 verified（是否蓝 V）可选。zh-weekly、en-notes 两段是「认同 + 复述原帖细节 + 补一句」的写法。zh-move 有回复别人评论的回复，replyTo 是被回复的评论。打包进插件，设置页「用样例集测试」和 npm run test:live 都用它；test/unit/ai-reply-score.test.ts 检查格式。

parent.author: dev_lin
parent.text: 上线第三天，把注册流程从 5 步砍到 2 步，转化率从 11% 涨到 19%。砍掉的是填写公司名和选择行业。

replies.author: growth_hub_88
replies.text: 太有启发了！🚀 简化流程真的是提升转化的关键。用户体验永远是第一位的，你觉得还有哪些环节可以继续优化呢？💡

parent.text: Shipped our first paid plan yesterday. 14 signups, 3 refunds within an hour because the Stripe webhook double-charged them. Fixed now, but ouch.

parent.text: Hot take: most standups should be a Slack message. We switched our team of 6 to async updates for a month and nobody missed the meeting.

replies.author: lead_with_purpose
replies.text: This resonates deeply. Async updates save time, respect focus, and empower teams to work smarter. Ultimately, great teams communicate with intention.

parent.author: ops_wang
parent.text: 把周报改成了每周五下午自动生成：从 Linear 拉本周关闭的任务，按项目分组，再让模型写一段总结，发到飞书群。以前要花 40 分钟，现在 5 分钟检查一下就行。

replies.author: ai_tools_daily
replies.text: 这套很实用：Linear 拉任务 → 按项目分组 → 模型总结 → 发飞书，从 40 分钟降到 5 分钟，省下的时间很可观。要是能把没关掉的任务也单独列一栏，就更完整了。

replies.author: efficiency_lab
replies.text: 从 40 分钟到 5 分钟，这个提效很稳。拉数据交给脚本，人只做最后检查，分工很清晰。总结那步是用固定模板，还是每周让模型自由写？

replies.author: laozhang_dev
replies.text: 我们也这么干过，后来老板说模型写的总结太像通稿，又改回手写了 哈哈

replies.author: workflow_note
replies.text: 按项目分组再总结这一步很关键，信息不会散。脚本拉取 + 人工复核，比纯手写稳多了，周报的源头也只剩 Linear 一个。

replies.author: xiaoqi_pm
replies.text: Linear 的 API 拉已关闭任务是按 UTC 算的吧，周五下午跑的话东八区周五晚上关的会不会漏？我之前就漏过两次

replies.author: mumu
replies.text: 5 分钟检查是真的吗 我每次光改模型写错的项目名就要 10 分钟

replies.author: agent_builder_cn
replies.text: Linear → 模型 → 飞书群，这条链路很清晰。最省心的是任务源头只有一个，周报不会漏项，也不用再挨个翻看板。

parent.author: dana_codes
parent.text: Moved all my meeting notes to plain markdown files in one git repo. A small script tags them by project and pushes a weekly digest to Slack. Search is just ripgrep now, and I stopped paying for two note apps.

replies.author: ai_workflow_pro
replies.text: Love this setup: markdown in one repo → script tags by project → weekly digest to Slack. One source of truth, and ripgrep makes search instant. Would be even better if the digest also flagged action items.

replies.author: build_in_public_ai
replies.text: Plain markdown + git is such a solid foundation. Dropping two paid note apps for ripgrep is a clean win. Do you tag notes with front matter, or does the script infer the project from the folder?

replies.author: sam_k
replies.text: tried this for a year, the thing that killed it for me was images. pasting screenshots into md files in git got ugly fast. how do you handle those

replies.author: lean_stack_daily
replies.text: Keeping notes in one repo with a weekly Slack digest is solid. Simple tools, one place, and search just works. That's how note-taking should be.

replies.author: grepfan
replies.text: ripgrep over notes is underrated. I alias `notes` to `rg -i --type md ~/notes` and that's 90% of my usage

replies.author: pete_r
replies.text: lol I did the exact same thing and then rebuilt Notion in bash over 6 months. good luck
